cross_benchmark.rule: exact regenerate old seeded banks in original ordering; both receive same raw waveform, R4B2 additionally receives oracle normalization and accumulation time as in historical model; separately report information asymmetry; no threshold tuning; each trace has hash

phase.generator: new independent code: irregular log sampling 600-1100 points, 5-8 cycles, variable power envelope, unknown accumulation time, chirp slopes and transient rivals, colored additive and multiplicative noise; same waveform across noise variants
phase.decision: three-way: DSS only if held-block validation and curvature equivalence confidence interval entirely within +-0.012 cycles over normalized log span; ambiguous otherwise if rival model not demonstrably better; explicit positive ambiguous <=5/100, positive correct >=90/100, near DSS false positives <=5/100 each stratum
phase.ci: fit sinusoidal chirp by nonlinear variable projection, approximate sandwich covariance from block sums for phase curvature, 95% interval; exploratory confidence not coverage-qualified
phase.oracle_control: known accumulation time and normalized envelope; evaluate separately from blind; no physical use
phase.blind_control: estimate nuisance time and envelope on training block only via bounded candidate scan; not guaranteed identifiable; all precommit thresholds same; report failure and coverage
